messages:
maria: Heads-up — new customer org 'orion' onboarding. Need to pre-provision GPU + network quotas in us-west1 (GCP) and eu-west-4 (AWS eu-west-1) before we hand off to SEs. Starting a quick checklist.

ajay: Thanks — can you list exact quota numbers you want? GPUs, external IPs, subnets, and any NLB limits?

maria: Tentative numbers: 20 x A100-40GB (GCP) in us-west1, 10 x A10G (AWS p4?) in eu-west-4 region, 200 external IPs across both clouds, increase forwarding rules to 50, and bump VPC subnet /20s per region.

sara: For AWS, correct instance class will be p4d or g5? A10G is ambiguous. We should use p4d for prod inference pools. Also need EFA quotas if they'll use MPI.

maria: Good call. Change to 12 x p4d (eu-west-1), 8 x g5.xlarge for batch dev. GCP keep A100-40GB 20.

leo: I'll open the support requests. For GCP I need: Compute Engine -> GPUs (A100) quota to 20 in us-west1, External IP addresses quota to 150 in that project, and CPU quota bump for region to match. For AWS open cases for EC2 On-Demand vCPUs and ENIs.

leo: Draft support note for GCP:

```
Project: projects/orion-prod (billing: B-0a1b2c3d)
Request: Increase "GPUs (A100)" to 20 in us-west1
Reason: Dedicated inference pool for orion, expected steady throughput 1000 req/s, SLA 99.9%%
Cost estimate: ~$12k/mo (on-demand) — customer will sign reserved commit after pilot
Please increase External IPs to 100 for region and Global External IPs to 50 for load balancers.
```

maria: Add a note to request support for quota propagation to our shared VPC if they attach to a host project.

ajay: IAM checklist:
- Create org-level groups: infra-orion-admins, infra-orion-operators
- Service accounts: orion-infer-sa, orion-deploy-sa
- Grant roles: roles/compute.admin (scoped by project), roles/iam.serviceAccountUser for deploy pipeline
- Tagging: tag resources with team:orion, env:prod/staging, cost-center:orion-cs

leo: Also include terraform variable snippet for naming convention so SEs use correct prefixes:

```
variable "orion_prefix" { default = "orion" }
resource "google_compute_subnetwork" "orion_main" {
  name       = "${var.orion_prefix}-subnet-usw1"
  ip_cidr_range = "10.40.0.0/20"
  region     = "us-west1"
  network    = "projects/shared-vpc/global/networks/rex"
  labels = { team = "orion" env = "prod" }
}
```

infra-bot: Reminder: quota requests take 3-7 business days for GCP and 1-5 for AWS. Escalation path: submit support case -> respond to case with 'SRE escalation' -> reach out to partner rep if delayed.

sara: Networking notes:
- Reserve /20 per region for the cluster (enough IPs for pods + services + LB).
- Reserve a block for direct connect / interconnect: request VLAN attachments early.
- Check NACLs and default SG limits — increase ENI quota and security group rules if > 50 rules per SG expected.

maria: Cost/commit plan: Run on-demand for first 2 weeks, measure 95th percentile. If steady, recommend 12-month reserved commit for 60%% of usage. Add this to the support ticket as "usage profile".

ajay: Can someone verify billing account ID we should attach? I have a list but want to avoid attaching to a personal/old account.

leo: Billing: B-0a1b2c3d is the correct production billing account for orion. Tag the project with billing:orion-prod.

maria: Approval request: @ajay @leo can you sign off on numbers so I can file formal quota increases and IAM groups?

ajay: Signed off for IAM and tags. :thumbsup:

leo: Signed off for quota numbers except I'll drop external IPs to 120 and keep forwarding rules at 40 to start. We can increase later.

maria: Updated — I'll file GCP case and open AWS support ticket. I'll paste case IDs back here.

leo: GCP case created: case 1234567890. ETA 4 business days.

maria: AWS case: 9876543210. AWS asked for expected vCPU monthly usage and ARNs for service accounts.

infra-bot: To-do created: /tasks create "onboard-orion-quotas" assigned to leo, due in 5 days.

maria: Thanks team — I'll follow up with SEs and ping when quotas are confirmed.

sara: Quick checklist recap (for handoff):
1) Quota requests submitted (GCP/AWS)
2) Subnet /20 reserved per region
3) IAM groups + SA created
4) Billing account attached and project tagged
5) Terraform naming snippet added to repo
6) Escalation contacts listed in ticket

maria: Perfect. Closing thread after quotas confirmed.
